question: Should CodexBar adopt the proposed universal quota-planning model—learned fundable capacity as the headline, theoretical reset capacity as context, and an initial Codex/Claude/Antigravity rollout—as the implementation direction for https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2261?
rationale: The document selects user-visible metrics, confidence gates, provider eligibility, and rollout scope; those are product-contract choices rather than mechanical documentation corrections.

options.title: Confirm the scoped design
options.body: Accept the N/M/reachability model and use this document as the contract for a future, separately reviewed implementation.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Keep the design draft but limit its provider scope or revise the headline metric before it becomes implementation guidance.

options.title: Keep exploration outside the repository
options.body: Decline this as a repository design artifact and continue product exploration in the linked issue until a smaller direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Confirm the scoped design
recommendation.body: Accept the N/M/reachability model and use this document as the contract for a future, separately reviewed implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue is the stated source of maintainer direction and this decision governs the repository's product surface.
